Post 1:

Built an anti-fabrication entailment guard into Aether because I got tired of watching job search tools hallucinate. Your resume tailoring and cover letters are grounded entirely in what you've actually done — sourced from your real resume and story bank. If the system can't prove a claim from your history, it reverts it. No invented achievements. No magical skills you never built. Just honest positioning of who you actually are.

https://5cb5f0620.abacusai.cloud

#jobsearch #honesttech #aitools

===

Post 2:

Every application, every outbound email from Aether waits in a human approval queue. Nothing ships without your explicit yes. I've seen "productivity" tools that spray applications across job boards and hit send on emails without you ever seeing them. That's not productivity — that's outsourcing your own judgment to a bot. You stay in control. You see what's going out under your name.

https://5cb5f0620.abacusai.cloud

#agency #jobhunt #automation

===

Post 3:

I built Aether for my own job search because I was frustrated. The honest insight: job boards are noisy, AI tools are often dishonest, and recruiter inbox is chaotic. So I sourced from licensed APIs instead of scraping. Made the fit scoring transparent — not a black box percentage, but WHY a role matches you. Grounded cover letters in your actual story, not fiction. Kept you in the approval loop. Honest tooling wins because it builds trust. With the process. With yourself.

https://5cb5f0620.abacusai.cloud
